posts.html:
You must be talking about the new Experiment server.

Regarding the bolts, I don't think there is going to be any donation system, therefore you must earn money, power and respect.

As for the Admins, it was decided that the Experiment server doesn't need ALL the VentMob server staff to look after it, so for the moment, only Super Administrators have any powers on it. When they feel that more Admins are needed, they will work their way down the ranks.
